customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one to start a project.
customers.name: Customer
customers.search: Search by name, company or phone
customers.displayNameHint: A name you can identify this customer by.
customers.contactHint: Without an email or a phone this customer cannot be invited to the client portal.
customers.noProjects: No projects for this customer yet
customers.deleteBody: {{name}} will stop appearing in the panel, along with their properties. Jobs and documents are not deleted.

blocked.projects: This customer has jobs, so they cannot be deleted. Close or delete the jobs first.
blocked.documents: This customer has sent estimates or invoices, so they cannot be deleted.

customers.gone: This customer no longer exists. Someone deleted it.
customers.deleteHint: Deleting only removes them from the panel. Jobs and documents stay.

crews.empty: No crews yet. Create the first one so you can send it to a job.
crews.name: Crew
crews.colorHint: So you can tell it apart at a glance.
crews.noMembers: This crew has no workers on it yet.
crews.endMemberBody: They stop belonging as of today. Their history and hours are untouched.
crews.overlap: {{name}} already belongs to another crew on those dates.
crews.overlapWith: {{name}} already belongs to {{crew}} on those dates.
crews.peopleEmpty: No workers on file yet. Add the first one so you can put a crew together.
crews.payRateHint: Only you and your admins see it.
crews.contactHint: This is how they get into the app. A phone is enough.
crews.inviteHint: Hand it over in person. For security it won't be shown again.
crews.inviteHow: With this code the worker signs into the app and sets their password.
crews.regenerateBody: The old code stops working and {{name}} is signed out until they redeem the new one. This is also how you fix a forgotten password.
crews.deactivateBody: They can no longer sign in. Their hours and history are not deleted, and you can add them back later.
crews.alreadyMember: That worker is already part of your company.
crews.ownerExists: Your company already has an owner. There can only be one.
crews.contactRequired: An email or a phone is required.
crews.assignFromHint: The job's start date is suggested. The crew stays on that job until you mark it finished.
crews.noWorkingNow: This crew isn't assigned to any job.
crews.removeFromJobBody: It stops being a job for this crew as of today, and its workers stop seeing it in the app. It stays in the history, and clocked hours are untouched.
crews.deleteAssignmentBody: It's deleted as if it never existed. Use this only if you entered it by mistake: if the crew did work there, remove it from the job instead.
crews.searchWorkers: Search by name, phone or email
crews.noJobs: This crew hasn't been on any job yet.

statusHelp.INVITED: Hasn't redeemed their code yet, so they can't get into the app.
statusHelp.ACTIVE: Redeemed their code and signs into the app with their password.
statusHelp.INACTIVE: Can't get into the app. Generate a new code to give access back.

crews.statusIsAutomatic: The status is set by the system based on access — it isn't chosen.
crews.contactEditHint: This is how they get into the app.
crews.employmentHint: Sets whether you withhold their taxes.
crews.codeHidden: The code can't be looked up. If it was lost, generate a new one.
crews.codeActive: They already set their password. Generate a new one only to reset their access.

catalog.empty: No items in the catalog yet. Items with their cost are what show margin.

reports.empty: No projects to report on yet.

publish.empty: Nothing published yet. A finished project with clean photos is what ends up on the website.
